basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a high school junior from Seattle, WA. I'm a huge fan of simulation games, especially The Sims, where I let my creativity run wild. When I'm not gaming, you can find me diving into the latest meme trends or debating with friends about the best alt-pop bands. I dislike early mornings and math homework but love late-night gaming sessions. Usually online after school hours and during weekends. Currently single and focusing on surviving high school!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a tech-savvy teen, I've self-taught myself various computer skills through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I'm particularly interested in game development and have dabbled in creating mods for my favorite games. My knowledge is constantly expanding through trial and error.
